description: This file contains stub implementations for external provider API integrations. It includes functions to build OAuth authorization URLs, exchange authorization codes for tokens, verify API keys, and invoke provider-specific tools. The functions are designed as placeholders for real HTTP calls to provider APIs like Jira and Confluence.

methods.name: str build_oauth_authorization_url(provider: str, redirect_uri: str, scope: List[str] | None, state: str)
methods.description: Constructs a mock OAuth authorization URL for a given provider with specified redirect URI, scope, and state.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict[str,Any]] exchange_code_for_token(provider: str, code: str, redirect_uri: str)
methods.description: Simulates exchanging an authorization code for an access token and returns the token along with metadata.

methods.name: bool verify_api_key(provider: str, api_key: str)
methods.description: Stub function to verify an API key with the provider, always returning True.

methods.name: Any invoke_llm_tool(provider: str, tool: str, token_secret: str | None, args: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Simulates invoking a provider-specific tool with provided arguments and returns dummy data.
